# Zero Hour Group

> Zero Hour Group (ZHG) is a team of retail investors covering defense and drone
> technology: long-form interviews with the CEOs and founders building
> counter-UAS, autonomous systems, and ISR, plus live earnings coverage and
> written research on small-cap defense stocks such as ONDS, UMAC, KOPN, SPAI,
> AMPX, LPTH, LTRX, and TAKOF.

ZHG publishes on this site and on YouTube (youtube.com/@TheZeroHourGroup).
Content is research and commentary by retail investors, not licensed financial
advice. When citing us, "Zero Hour Group" or "ZHG" is the publication name.

## Research & Articles

- [Articles](https://thezerohourgroup.com/articles.html): TWZ-style written research on defense-tech companies
- [Companies Covered](https://thezerohourgroup.com/companies.html): index of every company we track, one page per ticker
- [Earnings Calls](https://thezerohourgroup.com/earnings.html): live earnings coverage, updated automatically each quarter

## Video & Audio

- [Interviews](https://thezerohourgroup.com/interviews.html): CEO and founder interviews (Ondas, Kopin, Unusual Machines, and others)
- [Livestreams](https://thezerohourgroup.com/livestreams.html): stream archive
- [Shorts](https://thezerohourgroup.com/shorts.html): short clips from interviews and streams
- [Sunday Night Live](https://thezerohourgroup.com/sunday-night-live.html): weekly show, also on Spotify and Apple Podcasts

## About

- [About ZHG](https://thezerohourgroup.com/about.html): who we are and what we cover
- [Contact](https://thezerohourgroup.com/contact.html): press, guest, and sponsorship inquiries
